optimizedContext.value:
# Change Archive

## Rules

- Canonical: `specd changes archive <name> [--skip-hooks <phases>] [--allow-overlap] [--format text|json|toon]`; alias: `specd change archive <name> [--skip-hooks <phases>] [--allow-overlap] [--format text|json|toon]`.
- `<name>` required change name.
- `--skip-hooks <phases>`: comma-separated `pre`, `post`, or `all`; omitted runs both phases. `all` skips every hook; caller must invoke `specd change run-hooks`.
- `--allow-overlap`: permit archive despite spec overlap with active changes.
- `--format text|json|toon`: default `text`.
- Change must be `archivable`. Missing change, other state, delta conflict, or parse failure exits 1; non-archivable error goes to stderr as `error:` naming current state.
- CLI delegates to `ArchiveChange`: merge all deltas into permanent spec directories; move change to path from `storage.archivePattern`; record archive history.
- Default `archiving` `run:` hooks: pre before file changes, post after archive. `--skip-hooks` maps to archive hook-phase selector on `ArchiveChangeInput`.
- Successful archive with failed post-hooks exits 2 and reports failures.
- Success `text`: archive path; when overlap invalidates changes, `invalidated N overlapping changes:` plus each change and overlapping specs. Omit section when none.
- Success `json`/`toon`: encoded `result: "ok"`, `name`, `archivePath`, and `invalidatedChanges` entries containing `name` and `specIds`; empty array when none. JSON exits 0.

## Constraints

- Archive only `archivable` changes.
- Archive path determined by `storage.archivePattern` in `specd.yaml`.
